notes.title: 🎬 Demo Co-Op Playthrough
notes.content:
[h2]Celebrate the launch of the Crimson Capes demo with us![/h2][p][/p][h3]All week long, we’ll be streaming epic battles — raw co-op hunts, ruthless invasions, and every deadly feint in between.[/h3][p][/p][p]If you’ve ever wanted to see what it’s [i]really[/i] like to fight side by side — or face off blade to blade — this is your call to arms.
[/p][p] Join the hunt and come meet us on the battlefield![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45054885/603ab58bff3ae36b2ba040b62c92db28473c6c82.png"][/img][/p]
